nodes.label: Lambda Cluster Training Setup
nodes.rationale: Guide for running OLMo-core training on the Lambda login/SLURM cluster: per-user repo dirs and uv virtualenvs, env vars (WANDB_API_KEY, USERNAME, optional SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL), pinned torch 2.8.0 / flash-attn / flash-linear-attention installs, and SLURM job submission.

nodes.label: SLURM launch.sh
nodes.rationale: launch.sh submits an sbatch script under SLURM taking (sbatch script, run name, number of nodes); it prints the job ID, waits for the job to start, then streams the logs.

nodes.label: launch_with_retries.sh
nodes.rationale: For long training jobs that should auto-resubmit after failures; takes the same arguments as launch.sh but continually resubmits until the job completes successfully, sending Slack notifications on failure when SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL is set.
